attributes.name: Title
attributes.value: Muscle Gene Expression Is a Marker of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Severity

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: This study was designed to identify gene expression changes in skeletal muscle that could define reliably the degree of the severity of Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). All samples were from human biopsies, either from healthy muscles or from muscle whose patients were clearly diagnosed as having Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Total RNA was isolated with Trizol and cleaned up on RNeasy Mini Columns. Target synthesis were done with SuperScript double-standard cDNA synthesis Kit (Invitrogen) followed by IVT using RNA Transcript labeling Kit T7 (Enzo). (Parameters: Extracted product = total_RNA, Amplification = RNA polymerases)
